Error type impact
Sorted by "Edge lost" — total R this mistake has cost you vs. your clean-trade baseline, worst first. "Win rate"/"Avg RR" count a trade toward every tag it carries (so they can add up to more than your total trades); "Solo WR (n)" isolates trades where this was the only tagged error, to check whether the mistake is bad on its own or only in combination — watch the n, small samples aren't conclusive.
Issue evolution over time
The top chart plots the % of that period's trades each error type was tagged on, so you can see which mistakes you're growing out of and which are creeping back in; the bottom chart shows the same trend in raw trade counts. Dashed green is your clean-trade rate for comparison. Click a name in the legend to isolate that line in both charts (hide the rest); click it again to bring everyone back.

JSON / CSV Backup & Restore
Export JSON
Full export of all trades, images, sessions, settings and preferences. Keep this as your portable data file — import it on any device or browser.
Export CSV
Download trade data as a spreadsheet. Useful for analysis in Excel or Google Sheets. Does not include images or settings.
Import (JSON or CSV)
Upload a JSON data file or CSV — format is detected automatically. JSON restores everything; CSV imports trades only. Duplicates are skipped.
GitHub Not configured
Repository Setup
Create a private GitHub repo (e.g. my-trading-journal), then generate a Personal Access Token at github.com/settings/tokens with repo scope. Your token is stored only in this browser.
Push to GitHub
Manually push your full journal (trades, images, sessions, settings) to your GitHub repo right now.
Pull from GitHub
Restore your journal from GitHub. Use this on a new browser or device. Existing data is merged (no duplicates).
Last sync
Never synced yet. Auto-sync runs after every trade save once configured.
Deploy to GitHub Pages
⚠ Use a separate public repo for Pages. GitHub Pages requires a public repo on free accounts. Your data repo must stay private — it contains your full trade history. Create a second repo (e.g. trading-journal-app) that holds only this HTML file. Your GitHub sync credentials still point at your private data repo — nothing changes there.
Steps to deploy:
  1. Create a new public repo on GitHub (e.g. trading-journal-app) — not your data repo
  2. Add this index.html file to your repo root
  3. Download the workflow file below and commit it to .github/workflows/deploy.yml
  4. In that repo's Settings → Pages, set source to GitHub Actions
  5. Push — your journal will be live at https://<user>.github.io/trading-journal-app
  6. On any new device, open the URL, go to Backup & Restore, enter your private data repo credentials and hit Pull
Backup & Snapshots
Manual Backup
Saves a timestamped trades snapshot to bkp/trades/ and overwrites the single config backup at bkp/config_backup.json with all current settings (strategies, checklist, pairs, columns, theme, defaults).
Restore Latest Trade Backup
Replace your current trades, sessions and settings with the most recent snapshot in bkp/trades/. To restore your config (strategies/checklist/pairs), use the Snapshots list below. This overwrites current data.
Trade Backups & Config Backup
bkp/trades/ · bkp/config_backup.json
Trade Backups — timestamped snapshots in bkp/trades/. Created automatically before session deletes and clear-all, or manually. Multiple snapshots kept so you can roll back to any point.

Config Backup — a single file at bkp/config_backup.json storing strategies, checklist, and asset pairs. Auto-updated whenever you change any of those, and on Manual Backup. Only one backup kept — always the latest.
Cloudinary — Image Hosting Not configured
When configured, screenshots are uploaded to Cloudinary (free tier: 25 GB) instead of being stored as base64. Your tj_data.json stays tiny — only image URLs are saved, not the image data itself.

Sign up free at cloudinary.com, then go to Settings → Upload → Upload presets and create an unsigned preset. Copy your Cloud Name from the dashboard.

⚠ Required for screenshot deletion: In your upload preset settings, under Upload Control, set Return delete token to Yes. Without this, removed screenshots will not be deleted from Cloudinary.
How it works: When you paste or drop a screenshot, it's uploaded instantly to Cloudinary. The image URL is stored in your trade. Your GitHub backup stays lean — no base64 blobs. Existing trades with base64 images continue to work normally.
Danger Zone
Clear all data
Permanently delete every trade and image. Export a backup above first! If GitHub is configured, a snapshot is auto-saved before deletion.

Cloudflare Worker — Deploy Guide Reference
No CLI needed. The worker is deployed entirely through the Cloudflare dashboard — copy, paste, save. A free account is all you need. All config (tokens, keys, alerts) is stored in KV and pushed from this page via Save and Sync.
Adding Cloud Monitor to a vanilla HTML copy?
Download the patch file — it has the three blocks (CSS, HTML, JS) you need to paste in, with exact search anchors for each insertion point.
1. CSS → paste before the </style> that follows .pa-updated-ago
2. HTML → paste before <!-- /page-price-alerts -->
3. JS → paste before the final </script> at end of file
  1. Create a free Cloudflare account at dash.cloudflare.com if you don't have one.
  2. Go to Workers & Pages → Overview, click Create → Create Worker. Name it (e.g. journup-price-alerts) and click Deploy.
  3. Click Edit code, delete the placeholder, paste the full price-alerts-worker.js contents (download below), then click Deploy.
  4. Create a KV namespace. Workers & Pages → KV → Create namespace. Name it JOURNUP_KV.
  5. Bind the KV namespace. Worker → Settings → Bindings → Add → KV namespace. Variable name: JOURNUP_KV (exact). Select the namespace. Save.
  6. (Optional) Worker Secret. Settings → Bindings → Add → Secret. Name: WORKER_SECRET. Enter the same value in the Worker Secret field above.
  7. Set cron trigger. Settings → Triggers → Cron Triggers → Add. */1 * * * * = every minute, */5 * * * * = every 5 min.
  8. Copy your worker URL, paste it into Cloudflare Worker URL above, then click Save and Sync.
⚠ KV binding variable name must be exactly JOURNUP_KV — a typo causes a runtime error.
Worker endpoints
POST /config — push tokens, keys & settings
GET  /config — read config from KV
POST /alerts — sync active alerts array
GET  /alerts — read alerts from KV
GET  /trigger_log — last 200 fired alert entries
POST /poll — manually trigger a price check now
GET  /status — worker health & alert counts
GET  /debug?sym=BTCUSDT — test all price providers for a symbol
GET  /price?symbol=EURUSD — live price fetch (no KV, direct from provider)
